name: M1A2 SEPv3 Abrams
variant_notes: M1A2 SEPv3 source OBJ (War Thunder extract). Base vehicle: camouflage nets, TUSK ERA tiles and their rails/frames and whip antennas omitted. Source CROWS replaced by the existing CROWSII model scaled to the source M2 and rendered as its own sprite; the loader M240 rotating assembly (pintle, gun, shield, ammo can) is a separate sprite. CITV stays. Turret-bustle ammunition blow-out panels are destructible overlays. RimThunder reference is its base M1A2 (SEP generation not stated); SEPv3 detail differences are recorded in ART_BRIEF.md. No blueprint.
